name.description: New display name for the group.

usergroup_id.description: ID of the user group to update (starts with 'S', e.g., 'S0123456789'). Get IDs from usergroups_list.

users.description: Comma-separated user IDs that will become the COMPLETE member list (e.g., 'U0123456789,U9876543210'). All current members not in this list will be removed.
